This is a source-based extraction and synthesis task — the user wants me to pull evidence from primary sources and a video clip and organize it into a coherent explanatory paragraph. That maps most directly onto Extraction & Retrieval and Summarization capabilities.

Whimbrel-235B scores higher on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 78.5), which is the most relevant dimension here since the task hinges on accurately drawing and citing evidence from the provided materials. Summarization is effectively a tie (80.3 vs 79.9, within variance).

Willet does score higher on Creative Generation, but this task is constrained and evidence-bound rather than open-ended invention, so that strength doesn't apply much here. The content is also benign historical material, so neither model's harm-aversion preferences are a factor.

Given the extraction-heavy nature of the request, Whimbrel was the better fit.
